items.title: Airbnb (ABNB) Brings Over 1 Million Listings To A Major Card Travel Portal

Eligible U.S. American Express Card Members can now earn Membership Rewards points and receive statement credits on Airbnb bookings made through Amex Travel. The arrangement connects Airbnb hosts with American Express's higher spending travel customers through a new distribution channel inside the issuer's booking portal.
